sentence: The efficiency gains of the corpus's null-baseline study need, among other conditions, sharper competitive pressure
passage: [Kazakis (2026), abstract] "Using a labor-based measure of AI investment, the baseline results show no direct association between AI investment and firm efficiency." / "The heterogeneity analysis indicates that efficiency gains materialize primarily when firms pair AI with capable managers, face stronger competitive pressure, have more stable institutional investor ownership, and are able to secure long-term debt."

gemini.note: The passage explicitly states that efficiency gains materialize when firms face stronger competitive pressure alongside other factors, fully supporting the sentence.
